name: Accounting to DWH via email CSV reader (DE)

parameters.query:
--форматирую данные в нужный формат
--drop table if exists accounting.de_input_02;
--Удаление существующего года
DELETE FROM accounting.de_input_02
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM transaction_date) = '{{ $('Edit Fields').item.json.year }}'
;

--

--CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounting.de_input_02 AS 
insert into accounting.de_input_02
(
SELECT 
    account AS distr_account,
    NULL AS distr_account_type,
    CASE
        WHEN date_of_booking ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
            THEN DATE '1REDACTED99-12-30' + (date_of_booking::numeric)::int
        ELSE to_date(date_of_booking, 'DD.MM.YYYY')
    END AS transaction_date,
    NULL AS transaction_type,
    booking_id AS tr_number,
    NULL AS name_,
    NULL AS item_class,
    description AS memo_descr,
    vendor AS item_split_account_full_name,
    (
    COALESCE(
        CAST(
            REPLACE(
                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(NULLIF(ct_pln, ''), '$', ''),
                    '.', ''
                ),
                ',', '.'
            ) AS numeric
        ),
        0
    )
    -
    COALESCE(
        CAST(
            REPLACE(
                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(NULLIF(dt_pln, ''), '$', ''),
                    '.', ''
                ),
                ',', '.'
            ) AS numeric
        ),
        0
    )
) AS amount
,
    NULL AS balance
FROM accounting.de_input_01
);

--
select * from accounting.de_input_02
limit 1;

--Таблица с полным данными для выгрузки
drop table if exists accounting.de_01;
--
CREATE TABLE if not exists accounting.de_01 as (
select
	input_02.distr_account,
	input_02.distr_account_type,
	input_02.transaction_date::date,
	input_02.transaction_type,
	input_02.tr_number,
	input_02.name_,
	input_02.item_class,
	input_02.memo_descr,
	input_02.item_split_account_full_name,
	input_02.amount * coalesce(coalesce(map_02.sign_,map_01.sign_), 1) as amount,
	input_02.balance,
	cao.acc_name_t1a,
	cao.bs_pl,
	cao.cash,
	plan_cao.id,
	plan_cao.account,
	plan_cao.l1,
	plan_cao.l2,
	plan_cao.l3,
	plan_cao.l4,
	plan_cao.l5,
	plan_cao.l6,
	'm' || TO_CHAR(input_02.transaction_date, 'YYYY-MM') as eop_yyyy_mm,
	'y' || TO_CHAR(input_02.transaction_date, 'YYYY') as eop_yyyy
	--plan_cao.project_efficiency_mapping
from accounting.de_input_02 as input_02
left join --план счетов
		(select distinct on (acc_name_qb)
			acc_name_qb,
			acc_name_t1a,
			bs_pl,
			cash 
		from accounting.de_cao_01) as cao
	on input_02.distr_account = cao.acc_name_qb
left join --маппинг иерархии счетов
		(SELECT DISTINCT ON (account)
		    id,
		    account,
		    l1,
		    l2,
		    l3,
		    l4,
		    l5,
		    l6
		FROM mrp.account_hier
		ORDER BY account)
	as plan_cao
	on cao.acc_name_t1a = plan_cao.account
left join --маппинг исключений по знаку #1
		(SELECT DISTINCT ON (transaction_type)
		    transaction_type,
		    sign_::decimal as sign_
		FROM accounting.de_map_01
		ORDER BY transaction_type)
	as map_01
	on input_02.transaction_type = map_01.transaction_type
left join --маппинг исключений по счету #2
		(SELECT DISTINCT ON (account)
		    account,
		    sign_::decimal as sign_
		FROM accounting.de_map_02
		ORDER BY account)
	as map_02
	on input_02.distr_account = map_02.account
where input_02.transaction_date >= '2025-01-01'
	and amount <> 0
);
--
select * from accounting.de_01
--limit 1;

--сверка с mrp
with mrp as 
		(select 
		u02."Reporting Month" as transaction_date,
		'm' || TO_CHAR(u02."Reporting Month", 'YYYY-MM') as eop_yyyy_mm,
		'y' || TO_CHAR(u02."Reporting Month", 'YYYY') as eop_yyyy,
		u02.l6,
		u02."Description" as memo_descr,
		coalesce(round(sum(u02."USD" / fx.fx_to_usd ),2), 0) * (1) as amount,
		--'MRP' as source_,
		u02.l4,
		u02."Account" as account_t1a
		from mrp.union_02 as u02
		left join project_result.fx as fx
			on 'EUR' = fx.currency 
			and u02."Reporting Month" = fx.reporting_month 
		where "Payer" = 'ACME DE'
			and "Reporting Month" >= '2025-01-01'
		group by
			transaction_date,
			eop_yyyy_mm,
			eop_yyyy,
			l6,
			memo_descr,
			l4,
			account_t1a
			),
	accounting as 
		(select 
		transaction_date,
		eop_yyyy_mm,
		eop_yyyy,
		l6,
		memo_descr,
		sum(amount) as amount,
		--'Accounting' as source_,
		l4,
		account as account_t1a		
		from accounting.de_01
		where l2 = 'Retained Earnings'
			and transaction_date >= '2025-01-01'
		group by
			transaction_date,
			eop_yyyy_mm,
			eop_yyyy,
			l6,
			memo_descr,
			l4,
			account_t1a
		)
(select *, '2.MRP' as source_  from mrp
	union all
select *, '1.Accounting' as source_  from accounting
	union all
select transaction_date,
		eop_yyyy_mm,
		eop_yyyy,
		l6,
		memo_descr,
		amount * (-1) as amount,
		l4,
		account_t1a,
		'3.diff' as source_
	from mrp
	union all
select *, '3.diff' as source_  from accounting
);

--Ошибки в маппинге
select distinct on (distr_account)
	distr_account,
	l5,
	l6
from accounting.de_01
where --l2 = 'Retained Earnings'
	--and 
  (l6 is null or l6 = '');

-- 1. Создание первичной таблицы истории (однократный запуск)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounting.de_01_h AS
SELECT
    distr_account,
    transaction_date,
    tr_number,
    SUM(amount) AS amount,
    acc_name_t1a,
    account,
    l2,
    l3,
    l4,
    l5,
    l6,
    eop_yyyy_mm,
    eop_yyyy,
    to_char(now(), '"v_"YYYY-MM-DD:HH24-MI') AS version_,
    'initial' AS action_
FROM accounting.de_01
WHERE l2 = 'Retained Earnings'
GROUP BY
    distr_account,
    transaction_date,
    tr_number,
    acc_name_t1a,
    account,
    l2,
    l3,
    l4,
    l5,
    l6,
    eop_yyyy_mm,
    eop_yyyy;

-- Индекс по ключу для производительности
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS de_01_h_key_idx
    ON accounting.de_01_h (
        distr_account,
        transaction_date,
        tr_number,
        acc_name_t1a,
        account,
        l2,
        l3,
        l4,
        l5,
        l6,
        eop_yyyy_mm,
        eop_yyyy
    );
-- Для удобства — материализуем текущий "срез" с агрегированием
-- только по нужным колонкам и l2 = 'Retained Earn'
WITH params AS (
    SELECT to_char(now(), '"v_"YYYY-MM-DD:HH24-MI') AS v
),

curr_agg AS (
    SELECT
        distr_account,
        transaction_date,
        tr_number,
        SUM(amount) AS amount,
        acc_name_t1a,
        account,
        l2,
        l3,
        l4,
        l5,
        l6,
        eop_yyyy_mm,
        eop_yyyy
    FROM accounting.de_01
    WHERE l2 = 'Retained Earnings'
    GROUP BY
        distr_account,
        transaction_date,
        tr_number,
        acc_name_t1a,
        account,
        l2,
        l3,
        l4,
        l5,
        l6,
        eop_yyyy_mm,
        eop_yyyy
),

-- 2. Агрегированное итоговое состояние истории по тем же колонкам
hist_agg AS (
    SELECT
        distr_account,
        transaction_date,
        tr_number,
        SUM(amount) AS amount,
        acc_name_t1a,
        account,
        l2,
        l3,
        l4,
        l5,
        l6,
        eop_yyyy_mm,
        eop_yyyy
    FROM accounting.de_01_h
    GROUP BY
        distr_account,
        transaction_date,
        tr_number,
        acc_name_t1a,
        account,
        l2,
        l3,
        l4,
        l5,
        l6,
        eop_yyyy_mm,
        eop_yyyy
),

-- 3. Новые строки (initial): есть в curr_agg, но нет в hist_agg
new_rows AS (
    SELECT
        c.distr_account,
        c.transaction_date,
        c.tr_number,
        c.amount,
        c.acc_name_t1a,
        c.account,
        c.l2,
        c.l3,
        c.l4,
        c.l5,
        c.l6,
        c.eop_yyyy_mm,
        c.eop_yyyy,
        p.v AS version_,
        'initial' AS action_
    FROM curr_agg c
    CROSS JOIN params p
    LEFT JOIN hist_agg h
      ON h.distr_account   = c.distr_account
     AND h.transaction_date = c.transaction_date
     AND h.tr_number       = c.tr_number
     AND h.acc_name_t1a    = c.acc_name_t1a
     AND h.account         = c.account
     AND h.l2              = c.l2
     AND h.l3              = c.l3
     AND h.l4              = c.l4
     AND h.l5              = c.l5
     AND h.l6              = c.l6
     AND h.eop_yyyy_mm     = c.eop_yyyy_mm
     AND h.eop_yyyy        = c.eop_yyyy
    WHERE h.distr_account IS NULL
),

-- 4. Удалённые строки (delete): есть в hist_agg, но нет в curr_agg
deleted_rows AS (
    SELECT
        h.distr_account,
        h.transaction_date,
        h.tr_number,
        -h.amount AS amount,  -- обратный знак агрегированной суммы
        h.acc_name_t1a,
        h.account,
        h.l2,
        h.l3,
        h.l4,
        h.l5,
        h.l6,
        h.eop_yyyy_mm,
        h.eop_yyyy,
        p.v AS version_,
        'delete' AS action_
    FROM hist_agg h
    CROSS JOIN params p
    LEFT JOIN curr_agg c
      ON c.distr_account   = h.distr_account
     AND c.transaction_date = h.transaction_date
     AND c.tr_number       = h.tr_number
     AND c.acc_name_t1a    = h.acc_name_t1a
     AND c.account         = h.account
     AND c.l2              = h.l2
     AND c.l3              = h.l3
     AND c.l4              = h.l4
     AND c.l5              = h.l5
     AND c.l6              = h.l6
     AND c.eop_yyyy_mm     = h.eop_yyyy_mm
     AND c.eop_yyyy        = h.eop_yyyy
    WHERE c.distr_account IS NULL
),

-- 5. Изменённые строки (correction):
-- ключ есть и там, и там, но хотя бы одно поле отличается.
-- amount = Δ между текущим агрегатом и агрегированной историей.
changed_rows AS (
    SELECT
        c.distr_account,
        c.transaction_date,
        c.tr_number,
        (c.amount - h.amount) AS amount,  -- дельта суммы
        c.acc_name_t1a,
        c.account,
        c.l2,
        c.l3,
        c.l4,
        c.l5,
        c.l6,
        c.eop_yyyy_mm,
        c.eop_yyyy,
        p.v AS version_,
        'correction' AS action_
    FROM curr_agg c
    JOIN hist_agg h
      ON h.distr_account   = c.distr_account
     AND h.transaction_date = c.transaction_date
     AND h.tr_number       = c.tr_number
     AND h.acc_name_t1a    = c.acc_name_t1a
     AND h.account         = c.account
     AND h.l2              = c.l2
     AND h.l3              = c.l3
     AND h.l4              = c.l4
     AND h.l5              = c.l5
     AND h.l6              = c.l6
     AND h.eop_yyyy_mm     = c.eop_yyyy_mm
     AND h.eop_yyyy        = c.eop_yyyy
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE
        c.amount          IS DISTINCT FROM h.amount OR
        c.acc_name_t1a    IS DISTINCT FROM h.acc_name_t1a OR
        c.account         IS DISTINCT FROM h.account OR
        c.l2              IS DISTINCT FROM h.l2 OR
        c.l3              IS DISTINCT FROM h.l3 OR
        c.l4              IS DISTINCT FROM h.l4 OR
        c.l5              IS DISTINCT FROM h.l5 OR
        c.l6              IS DISTINCT FROM h.l6 OR
        c.eop_yyyy_mm     IS DISTINCT FROM h.eop_yyyy_mm OR
        c.eop_yyyy        IS DISTINCT FROM h.eop_yyyy
)

-- 6. Вставка всех изменений в историю
INSERT INTO accounting.de_01_h (
    distr_account,
    transaction_date,
    tr_number,
    amount,
    acc_name_t1a,
    account,
    l2,
    l3,
    l4,
    l5,
    l6,
    eop_yyyy_mm,
    eop_yyyy,
    version_,
    action_
)
SELECT * FROM new_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM deleted_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM changed_rows;
--
-- 1. Добавляем новую колонку, если её ещё нет
ALTER TABLE accounting.de_01_h
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS version_type text;

ALTER TABLE accounting.de_01_h
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS action_h text;

-- 2. Ставим всем по умолчанию 'previous'
UPDATE accounting.de_01_h
SET version_type = '1.Previous',
	action_h = 'initial';

-- 3. Находим самую последнюю версию
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(version_) AS max_version
    FROM accounting.de_01_h
)

-- 4. Для строк с этой версией проставляем 'current'
UPDATE accounting.de_01_h h
SET version_type = '2.New',
	action_h = action_
FROM latest l
WHERE h.version_ = l.max_version;
--
select * from accounting.de_01_h;

--создание таблицы для Канады по входящим транзакциям
drop table if exists accounting.de_input_01;
--
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounting.de_input_01 (
    booking_id           text,
    date_of_booking      text,
    name_of_account_eng  text,
    t1a_account          text,
    account              text,
    dt_currency          text,
    ct_currency          text,
    currency             text,
    exchange_rate        text,
    dt_pln               text,
    ct_pln               text,
    description          text,
    register             text,
    vendor               text,
    vat                  text
);


--создание таблицы маппинга для на счет ACME
drop table if exists accounting.de_cao_01;
--
CREATE TABLE if not exists accounting.de_cao_01 (
acc_name_qb text,
acc_name_t1a text,
bs_pl text,
cash text
);

--Создание таблицы исключений №1 для маппинга знака по типу транзакции
drop table if exists accounting.de_map_01;
--
CREATE TABLE if not exists accounting.de_map_01 (
transaction_type text,
sign_ text
);

--Создание таблицы исключений №2 для маппинга знака по счету
drop table if exists accounting.de_map_02;
--
CREATE TABLE if not exists accounting.de_map_02 (
account text,
sign_ text
);

--форматирую данные в нужный формат
--drop table if exists accounting.de_input_02;
--Удаление существующего года
DELETE FROM accounting.de_input_02
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM transaction_date) = SPLIT_PART('{{ $('Edit Fields').item.json.year }}', '_', 1)::INT
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM transaction_date) = SPLIT_PART('{{ $('Edit Fields').item.json.year }}', '_', 2)::INT;

--

--CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounting.de_input_02 AS 
insert into accounting.de_input_02
(
SELECT 
    account AS distr_account,
    NULL AS distr_account_type,
    CASE
        WHEN date_of_booking ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
            THEN DATE '1REDACTED99-12-30' + (date_of_booking::numeric)::int
        ELSE to_date(date_of_booking, 'DD.MM.YYYY')
    END AS transaction_date,
    NULL AS transaction_type,
    booking_id AS tr_number,
    NULL AS name_,
    NULL AS item_class,
    description AS memo_descr,
    vendor AS item_split_account_full_name,
    (COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(NULLIF(ct_pln, ''), '$', ''), ',', '') AS numeric), 0)
     -
     COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(NULLIF(dt_pln, ''), '$', ''), ',', '') AS numeric), 0))
        AS amount,
    NULL AS balance
FROM accounting.de_input_01
);

--
select * from accounting.de_input_02
limit 1;
